name: Nafy AI Song Generator
original_description: Nafy AI creates original songs and instrumentals, AI song covers, song extensions, section replacements and voice changes directly inside ChatGPT. Choose songs from your connected Nafy library, including songs generated on the website, or upload audio in the plugin or attach it in the chat. Review settings and the exact credit cost, then confirm to create private results. Follow progress and listen to the finished audio here. Audio imports do not spend credits; editing requires an eligible Nafy account and sufficient existing credits. Voice change uses your ready Nafy voice models. File upload controls depend on the ChatGPT client; chat attachments provide another input path. Preview and storage availability depend on your storage entitlement. For copyright and commercial-use questions, consult https://nafy.ai/commercial-license; the plugin does not verify or grant licenses.
